cast.name: Count Dracula
cast.role: ancient Transylvanian noble and predatory biological monopoly invading London via real estate and maritime loopholes
cast.look: an aristocratic pale man in his early fifties with sharp aquiline features, cold piercing eyes, swept-back iron-grey hair, heavy silver moustache, dressed in high-collared Victorian black frock coat and dark woollen cape

cast.name: Jonathan Harker
cast.role: earnest young English solicitor's clerk who discovers Dracula's true nature and audits the vampire's movements
cast.look: a tidy English gentleman in his late twenties with neat sandy-brown parted hair, anxious intelligent grey eyes, wearing a dark charcoal wool three-piece suit with high stiff collar and silk cravat

cast.name: Mina Harker
cast.role: schoolmistress and analytical mastermind whose cross-indexed dossiers, shorthand, and reverse hypnosis dismantle Dracula
cast.look: a poised determined twenty-six-year-old woman with pinned-up dark auburn hair, thoughtful brown eyes, wearing an austere high-necked dark navy Victorian day dress with crisp white collar and lace cuffs

cast.name: Abraham Van Helsing
cast.role: Dutch polymath doctor and philosopher bridging advanced medicine and arcane folklore to coordinate the hunt
cast.look: an authoritative broad-shouldered man in his late fifties with receding iron-grey hair, penetrating blue eyes behind wire spectacles, bushy eyebrows, dressed in a tailored dark tweed overcoat and wool waistcoat

cast.name: Dr. John Seward
cast.role: earnest superintendent of the Purfleet lunatic asylum who records patient Renfield and the vampire hunt on wax cylinders
cast.look: a serious thoughtful physician in his early thirties with dark brown sideburns, tired strained eyes, wearing a dark brown tailored frock coat, dark vest and physician's pocket watch chain

cast.name: R. M. Renfield
cast.role: asylum patient whose zoophagous consumption of flies, spiders, and birds mirrors Dracula's metabolic life-absorption
cast.look: an intense dishevelled man in his late forties with erratic greying hair, wild manic eyes, hollow cheeks, wearing a rumpled grey institutional asylum jacket and collarless canvas shirt

cast.name: Lucy Westenra
cast.role: aristocratic debutante whose somnambulism and gradual vampiric infection expose Victorian somatic vulnerability
cast.look: a delicate pale twenty-year-old woman with golden blonde curls, vacant feverish blue eyes, wearing a flowing white Victorian nightgown with high lace trim

cast.name: Quincey Morris
cast.role: wealthy adventurous American hunter from Texas who finances the expedition and delivers the fatal heart strike
cast.look: a tall sunburnt athletic man in his late twenties with dark short hair, steady grey eyes, wearing a rugged brown leather travelling coat, wide-brimmed felt hat and sturdy leather holster
